Laurence Darmiento
Staff writer,
Business
Los Angeles Times
Mobile: 818.903.8135



On Fri, Oct 16, 2026 at 6:32 PM Lisa Monelli <info@myvilla.la> wrote:

> Hi Laurence,
>
> Your voter guide on the Allen-Kim insurance commissioner race was a
> clear, useful breakdown, especially the section on how each candidate
> would approach California's wildfire insurance crisis and the push for
> more fire-resistant rebuilding standards.
>
> My Villa builds Italian-designed homes in Los Angeles using reinforced
> concrete, cemento a vista, a construction method common across the
> Mediterranean precisely because it withstands fire, seismic stress and
> time far better than wood framing. As California rethinks what
> "insurable" construction looks like, that tradition feels newly
> relevant.
>
> Would you be open to receiving some background material, or a short
> call with our founder, Paolo Mezzalama, if this angle is useful for
> future coverage.
>
> Best,
> Lisa Monelli
> My Villa Media Team
> info@myvilla.la · myvilla.la
>
